name: Office Setup Variant 1
task:
Please complete the following four-stage office task.

=== Stage 1: Supply Gathering ===
You need to prepare 3 copies of a 10-page report. Supplies: 30 sheets of paper in the printer tray, 3 folders on the shelf, a stapler with 50 staples on the desk, a shredder under the desk, and a binder on the cabinet.

=== Stage 2: Document Preparation ===
Print and organize the documents.

=== Stage 3: Assembly ===
Bind and compile the documents.

=== Stage 4: Cleanup ===
Dispose of waste and organize workspace.
